title: Spatially intensified coastal upwelling
query:
Investigate why summer upwelling is spatially uneven along the eastern Guangdong shelf in the 2011 CMOMS simulation. Evaluate the roles of shelf geometry and cross-shelf circulation using the available hydrographic and velocity fields.

Independently identify relevant literature and appropriate methods. Deliver an evidence-based report, supporting figures, and one executable analysis notebook. Distinguish demonstrated results from mechanisms that the supplied data cannot establish.
